Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The change affects posted G-code.
I found no blocking changes to request.

What looks good:

- The XY reflection changes the yaw sign only when one axis is flipped.
- The shared post passes carry the combined frame through Bake and Control modes.
- The tests compare controller paths, arc paths, compensation sides, and drilled holes with the CAM path.
- The app tests check viewer positions, setup sheets, travel limits, and the off-Z refusal.
- The existing refusals remain for flipped Z, probing, and unsupported Control configurations.
- The decision file explains the transform order and the alternatives.

Local results:

The trial merge used upstream/main at `475373093cde8974c467a6855693cbdadf4827a4`.
Git reported `Already up to date.` The PR contains that main commit.
The review used the current AGENTS.md from upstream/main.
All commands ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2782`. No GitHub runner ran.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: all 79 steps passed in 6.5 minutes.
- The gate built both touched crates with `cargo test --no-run`.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `git diff --check`: passed. The worktree was clean after the mutations.

The quick gate ran 77 test suites: 1048 tests passed, 0 failed, and 1 existing test was ignored.

Mutations repeated for this review:

   `flipped_yaw_bake_traces_the_cam_path` failed with the old combined-frame refusal (exit 101).
   I restored the fix. The same test passed (exit 0).
2. I removed the yaw sign correction from the fixed flip pass.
   `flipped_yaw_control_traces_the_cam_path_in_each_rotation_dialect` failed at the angle check (exit 101).
   I restored the fix. All 3 tests in `wcs_flip_rotated` passed (exit 0).

I made no persistent source changes. I committed no review evidence.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes:

- No goldens moved. There are no changed `.nc` or `.cl` lines to inspect.
- No UI file changed. Before and after screenshots are not required for this diff.
- No dependency, build script, workflow, or process file changed.
- No physical controller test or release gate ran.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
